song.lyrics:
[V1] .G C G Who else commands all the hosts of heaven? .Em C G Who else could make every king bow down? .Em C G Who else can whisper and darkness trembles? .C D G Only a Holy God
[V2] .G C G What other beauty demands such praises? .Em C G What other splendor outshines the sun? .Em C G What other majesty rules with justice? .C D G Only a Holy God
[C1] . C Come and behold Him . G D The One and the Only . C Cry out, sing holy . G D Em Forever a Holy God . C D G Come and worship the Holy God
[V3] .G C G What other glory consumes like fire? .Em C G What other power can raise the dead? .Em C G What other name remains undefeated? .C D G Only a Holy God
[V4] .G C G Who else could rescue me from my failing? .Em C G Who else would offer His only Son? .Em C G Who else invites me to call Him Father? .C D G Only a Holy God .C D G Only my Holy God
song.title: Only a Holy God
song.author: CityAlight
